messages:
Talia: Hi all, Talia here (starting today!). My monitor stand arrived but the VESA screws are missing and the power brick for the monitor wasn't in the box. Plugging monitor in shows no power. Who should I ping for replacement parts?
it-ops: welcome Talia :wave: sorry about that. Can you share the monitor model (sticker on back) and the packing slip photo? we'll file an RMA with vendor.
Talia: model is Dell U2723QE, serial S/N xxxxxx (pic uploaded to onboarding ticket). Packing slip says 'stand + cable', but only stand and HDMI were in box.
shipping-bot: Package 47218 scanned at 2026-03-10 09:14 PST. Items shipped: stand, HDMI cable, power_cable (qty:1). Delivery manifest mismatch reported. Created vendor claim VC-9942.
Noah: hey Talia, I'm floor IT - for a quick workaround we can loan you a power brick + M4 VESA screws from our spares kit. I can drop by in 30m if you're in SF-3.
Talia: that would be amazing, I'm at SF-3B desk 18. Thank you!
Asha: tagging here for admin approvals on RMA credit. @Noah if you pick up a spare, please add to INC-6008 and mark as loaner asset so we track returns.
it-bot: created incident INC-6008 for Talia (priority: low)  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-6008
Noah: grabbing spare screw kit and an extra Dell brick now. ETA 25m. Also will test monitor power at desk before I leave.
Talia: awesome, thanks Noah! Do we also need a new HDMI->USB-C adapter? My laptop is USB-C only.
it-ops: we usually provide a USB-C cable in the new-hire kit but sometimes HDMI adapters are shipped. Check the dock — if you have a dock it will pass display. If not, Noah can bring a USB-C cable as well.
Noah: I brought a USB-C cable and a spare USB-C power injector (just in case).
Talia: Noah arrived and installed the power brick and tested  monitor powered on and display is great. He left the screw kit and a USB-C cable as loaners. Thanks so much! :raised_hands:
Asha: noting in INC-6008: loaner items given (power_brick, vesa_screws_kit, usb-c_cable). Shipping claim VC-9942 assigned to VendorOps for follow-up.
shipping-bot: VendorOps updated VC-9942: vendor responded, confirmed missing items during pick/pack, vendor shipping replacement power_cable + screws, ETA 5 business days. RMA credit initiated.
Talia: perfect. Should I return the loaner items when vendor parts arrive?
it-ops: yep, please return to IT dropbox (Mailroom B) and mark INC-6008 resolved with serials if any. We'll put reminder on your calendar for 6 days from now.
Talia: will do. Thanks so much everyone  excited to be here! :sparkles:
it-bot: INC-6008 updated to "in-progress".
